challenges.title: Build a Dark Mode Toggle
challenges.description: Implement a robust dark mode toggle using CSS variables and local storage to persist user preferences across sessions. Focus on smooth transitions and semantic color mapping.
challenges.instructions:
1. Select your toggle switch button from DOM.
2. Add event listener to toggle 'dark' class on <html> document.
3. Store user selection in LocalStorage.
4. Apply dark state on page load based on storage.
